io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options

Class SlimefunGuideSettings

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options.SlimefunGuideSettings

  • public final class SlimefunGuideSettings
extends java.lang.Object
    This static utility class offers various methods that provide access to the Settings menu of our SlimefunGuide. This menu is used to allow a Player to change things such as the Language.
    See Also:
    SlimefunGuide

      • hasFireworksEnabled

        public static boolean hasFireworksEnabled(@Nonnull
                                          org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        This method checks if the given Player has enabled the FireworksOption in their SlimefunGuide. If they enabled this setting, they will see fireworks when they unlock a Research.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player
        Returns:
        Whether this Player wants to see fireworks when unlocking a Research

      • hasLearningAnimationEnabled

        public static boolean hasLearningAnimationEnabled(@Nonnull
                                                  org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        This method checks if the given Player has enabled the LearningAnimationOption in their SlimefunGuide. If they enabled this setting, they will see messages in chat about the progress of their Research.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player
        Returns:
        Whether this Player wants to info messages in chat when unlocking a Research

      • hasMachineMessagesEnabled

        public static boolean hasMachineMessagesEnabled(@Nonnull
                                                org.bukkit.entity.Player p)

        Parameters:

        Returns:

      • isMainMenuCategorized

        public static boolean isMainMenuCategorized(@Nonnull
                                            org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Whether the guide's main menu should be grouped into themes (the reworked layout) for this Player. When false, the main menu lists every category directly (the classic flat layout). Per-player, defaulting to the server's guide.categorize-main-menu value.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player
        Returns:
        Whether the main menu is categorized for this Player

      • hasAutoCraftAmbientSound

        public static boolean hasAutoCraftAmbientSound(@Nonnull
                                               org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Whether the given Player hears the sound a nearby multiblock plays when it auto-crafts via redstone. Per-player, defaulting to the server's auto-craft.sound.everyone value.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player
        Returns:
        Whether nearby auto-craft sounds should be played to this Player
